cards.name: Photocopy
cards.summary: Simulates a cheap high-contrast photocopy: large dark areas are copied mostly around their edges and midtones drop to solid Foreground colour or to Background colour (black toner on white with the default swatches), so the image becomes an outline-heavy, toner-like sketch. Detail sets how much fine edge survives, Darkness how heavy the toner is.
use_for: punk / zine / xerox-collage flyers and posters
grunge outline treatment of a portrait for a protest or music poster
line-art base for tracing or Image Trace
photocopy texture layer in Multiply over colour
avoid: keeping the photo's colours: like most Sketch filters it repaints the whole layer in the Foreground and Background swatch colours (black / white by default), so the colour is gone; set the swatches first, or use Edit > Fade / Smart Filter blending to mix it back over the colour photo

cards.name: Plaster
cards.summary: Moulds the image out of wet, glossy 3D plaster: the picture is thresholded into shapes that are puffed up into shiny, rounded blobs lit from one side and coloured with the Foreground / Background swatches; dark areas come out raised and light areas sunken. Image Balance sets the threshold, Smoothness how rounded the forms are, Light Direction the lit side.
use_for: liquid, molten or goo look on a bold logo, icon or headline shape (rasterised)
abstract glossy 3D blob textures for backgrounds
surreal or slime-themed poster art
avoid: detailed photos and faces: they turn into unreadable glossy blobs; use it on bold, simple shapes
